bookmark_id.description: Stable identifier for this bookmark (e.g., uuid or digest-derived id).

type.description: Whether this bookmark grants access to a specific file or a directory subtree.

subscope_rule.description: Optional rule for allowable sub-scope claims (e.g., relative path pattern).

display_name.description: UX label for prompts/history; not security-relevant.

path_hint.description: Optional best-effort path for UX only; must not be relied on for access control.

stable_id_hint.description: Optional stable identifier hint (e.g., file handle digest, dataset+object id).

cap_ref_digest.description: Digest of opaque portal-side reference needed to re-open the target. Never include raw tokens.

bindings.description: Binds bookmarks to the decision/evidence trail that authorized them.

constraints.description: Optional constraints (TTL defaults, max_bytes, write_requires_prompt, etc.).

expires_at.description: ISO8601 time; optional but recommended for long-lived bookmarks.
